body.name: Full blocked covariance model
body.construction: For \(E\in\mathfrak S_p\), let \(b_E=\sum_{j\in V}|\Pi^E_j|\), \(\Theta_E=\mathbb R^{b_E}\times(0,\infty)^p\), and \[\mathcal M(E)=\left\{(I_p-B_E(\beta_E))^{-1}\operatorname{diag}(\omega_E)(I_p-B_E(\beta_E))^{-\mathsf T}:(\beta_E,\omega_E)\in\Theta_E\right\}.\] Here \(B_E(\beta_E)_{ji}=\beta_{jB}\) for \(i\in B\in\Pi^E_j\), and all real block coefficients are admitted.
